changes.summary: Exclude browser policy reports from extension-protocol scripts while retaining application reports and crashes.
Group generated chunk resource failures across build hashes while retaining original event URLs and distinct resource origins, paths, extensions and kinds.

changes.detail: Elysia 2.0.0-rc.0 renamed every lifecycle hook to its `on` form and removed setup/cleanup (now onStart/onStop). This package now builds and tests against Elysia 2.0.0-rc.0 and requires `elysia ^2.0.0-rc.0`, which also accepts later release candidates and 2.0.0. Its server plugin now registers onRequest, onError and onAfterResponse, and stops its browser-ingest drainer in onStop (cleanup was removed).

migration.instruction: Upgrade `elysia` and every `@elysia/*` package to 2.0.0-rc.0 or later, then rename lifecycle hooks in your own server: request → onRequest, beforeHandle → onBeforeHandle, afterHandle → onAfterHandle, afterResponse → onAfterResponse, error → onError, parse → onParse, transform → onTransform; setup/cleanup → onStart/onStop. absolutejs/scripts codemods/elysia-rc-hooks.ts does the renames (run it before upgrading Elysia).

changes.summary: Group native member-call TypeErrors across renamed minified receivers and Safari explanatory suffixes while preserving property, method, and source identity. Historical issue IDs are not rewritten.

Normalize random /tmp/tmp.* deployment roots in default fingerprints while preserving file and function identity and original stacks. Existing issue IDs are not migrated; affected future captures receive the normalized fingerprint.
